units.source_text: 我们相约翌日早晨八点从汤野出发。

en.t: We agreed to leave Yuno at eight the next morning.

units.source_text: 我将大学预科制帽塞进书包，戴上在公共浴场旁边店铺买来的便帽，向沿街的小客店走去。

en.t: I stuffed my university preparatory school cap into my book bag, put on the cloth cap I had bought at the shop beside the public bath, and walked toward the small inn along the street.
The doors and windows on the second floor were all wide open.

units.source_text: 我无意之间走了上去，只见艺人们还睡在榻榻米上。

en.t: Without really thinking, I went upstairs and saw that the performers were still asleep on the tatami.

units.source_text: 我惊慌失措，呆呆地站在廊道里。

en.t: Flustered and at a loss, I stood blankly in the corridor.
